one_line: Chief minister of King Ajatashatru, weighing war against the Vajji gana-sangha in 5th century BCE Rajagriha.

appearance.age_look: Mid-40s, lean but sturdy build, average height with a slightly formal, upright posture.
appearance.face: Oval face with a calm, calculating look; medium-brown North Indian complexion; sharp nose, thin lips, neatly trimmed short beard and moustache, and slightly furrowed brows; default expression is composed and observant, as if always assessing the room.
appearance.hair: Black hair pulled back into a tight, low knot at the back of the head, with a narrow gold headband circling the forehead; hairline receding slightly at the temples to suggest age and seniority.
appearance.costume: He wears a long, cream-coloured, finely woven cotton uttariya (upper cloth) draped over both shoulders and wrapped snugly around the torso, leaving the chest fully covered, paired with a straight, ankle-length dhoti of muted maroon wrapped neatly and knotted at the waist; over this, a sleeveless, close-fitting light-brown cotton vest-like garment (early courtly tunic) reaches mid-thigh, edged with a thin dark-red border; a broad plain brown cloth belt secures the waist; his feet are in simple dark leather sandals; jewellery is restrained—small gold stud earrings, a single thin gold bangle on the right wrist, and a simple cord amulet visible at the neck; the textiles are plain with subtle narrow border stripes, conveying high but understated status fitting Magadhan court culture rather than flamboyant display.
appearance.signature: A rolled palm-leaf manuscript bundle, bound with a red cord and tucked under his left arm or held in his hand, symbolising his role as a minister and bearer of counsel, with a simple wooden stylus tucked into the belt.

ref_desc: Vassakara is a mid-40s, lean North Indian man with an oval face, medium-brown complexion, short beard, black hair in a tight low knot with a narrow gold headband, wearing a cream uttariya, muted maroon ankle-length dhoti, light-brown sleeveless vest with dark-red edging, plain brown belt, simple sandals, minimal gold jewellery, and carrying a rolled palm-leaf manuscript bundle with a wooden stylus, in a cream, maroon, brown and gold palette.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full-body anime-style model sheet of Vassakara, chief minister of Magadha: a mid-40s, lean North Indian man with an oval face, medium-brown complexion, sharp features, and a calm, calculating expression; he has a neatly trimmed short beard and moustache, slightly furrowed brows, and black hair pulled into a tight low knot at the back of his head, circled by a narrow gold headband with a modest sheen. His attire is early historic 5th century BCE courtly: a cream-coloured cotton uttariya draped over both shoulders and wrapped securely around his fully covered torso, over a straight, ankle-length muted maroon dhoti wrapped and tied neatly at the waist; on top he wears a sleeveless, close-fitting light-brown vest-like tunic reaching mid-thigh, edged with a thin dark-red border, all secured by a plain broad brown cloth belt. His feet are in simple dark brown leather sandals. Jewellery is restrained: small gold stud earrings, a single thin gold bangle on his right wrist, and a simple cord amulet at the neck. In his hands he prominently holds a rolled palm-leaf manuscript bundle bound with a red cord, with a simple wooden stylus tucked into his belt, emphasising his role as a minister and strategist; colours should focus on cream, muted maroon, light and dark browns, and small gold accents, shown consistently from front, side and back views in a clean character sheet style.
